notes.title: Official launch & Notice for online play
notes.notes:
[h3]■ <SNOW BROS. 2 SPECIAL> is now officially launched.[/h3]

<SNOW BROS. 2 SPECIAL> features original game from 1994 as well as graphically upgraded remake mode. The game has also been enhanced with new stages, monsters, bosses and various new modes like Survival, Time Attack, Sky Run. 


[h3]■ Online co-op play notice[/h3]

We provide a separate build to make online co-op play more enjoyable. 

This build utilizes Steam's Betas feature and contains the same content as the original build, only the server used for online play is different. If you're looking for more stable network experience when playing online co-op, please choose the more comfortable build.

How to access the beta build

- Right-click on <SNOW BROS. 2 SPECIAL> in Steam Library
- Select 'Properties'
- Click ‘Betas’ tab
- Select 'steamonly - steam' at Beta Participation
- Able to play after build update

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44816092/831ea96f7b949dc7723608106ce808296798eb36.png[/img]

* Note
When using the “steamonly” build, online co-op is not available with Nintendo Switch users.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2340640/SNOW_BROS_2_SPECIAL/

notes.title: [SNOW BROS. 2 SPECIAL] April 9th, 2025 official launch announcement
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce official release date of [SNOW BROS. 2 SPECIAL] is upcoming April 10th.

[h3]■ Launching time: April 09th, 2025  PDT 8:00[/h3]

[previewyoutube=wS0ax0TUmrA;full][/previewyoutube]
Enjoy the original storyline of rescuing a princess from the Demon King, but now with four protagonists whose character designs and graphics have been upgraded to fit the remake's new modern style while retaining their unique qualities.

Support for four-player multiplayer has been added, providing a variety of fun along with a number of new modes such as Original Mode, Survival Mode, Time Attack Mode and Sky Run. 

Add [SNOW BROS. 2 SPECIAL] to your Wishlist and play demo now.

notes.title: SNOW BROS. WONDERLAND WINS COOL AWARD!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45297176/d2f3991ce30e1359766eca1d79def8c693ad91bf.png[/img]

We’ve said it from the start, and we’re thrilled to say it again—[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3214870/Snow_Bros_Wonderland/]Snow Bros. Wonderland[/url] is an absolutely excellent co-op game! Partly because it strikes the perfect balance between serious gameplay and lighthearted fun. Partly because it’s so easy and accessible to jump in and out of whenever you like. And also because it’s so fitting for the season. After all, who wouldn’t want to spend time with loved ones during these magical holiday times?

Now, it seems the wonderful folks at Video Chums agree with us. In their Indie Game of the Year Awards 2024, they’ve named Snow Bros. Wonderland the Co-op Game of the Year! We’re honored!

https://videochums.com/article/indie-game-of-the-year-awards-2024#snow-bros-wonderland

So, are you looking for a snowy arcade adventure to share with up to three friends? Give Snow Bros. Wonderland a chance—it’s sure to brighten up the winter darkness!
